title: The man with the airport badge
scenario: At arrivals, someone with an airport lanyard says ride-hailing pickups have moved because of construction. He points to a printed QR code for the “temporary official taxi queue” and says app pickups are being cancelled.

answers.A: Ask the person where the official taxi rank is and walk there without scanning the code.
answers.B: Scan the QR code but compare the fare with your ride-hailing app before paying anything.
answers.C: Check the airport signs/app or ask the staffed transport desk where licensed pickups are actually operating.

explanation: A badge and confident explanation can manufacture authority. Physical transport changes should be confirmed with the airport or operator.
proTip: Confidence plus a lanyard is not a transport licence.
